name: crypto
notes: Captured on host floki (Intel Core Ultra 7 258V, 8 threads, Linux x86_64), not a quiescent CI runner; other processes were competing for CPU during the run (load average ~9-25). Case-level medians are therefore machine- and load-specific, but the gate compares relative regression (per-case % change against this same host's own baseline), not absolute time, so that is consistent with the gate's design. All 13 cases (aes_encrypt/decrypt x 5 sizes, rsa_oaep_encrypt/decrypt, pem_load_rsa_2048) recorded under criterion baseline name stage-15 at target/criterion/<case>/stage-15/ (gitignored; not committed). To re-baseline: cargo bench --bench crypto -p dynomite-engine -- --save-baseline stage-15 on a quiescent host, then update captured/git_sha here. To check for regressions: cargo bench --bench crypto -p dynomite-engine -- --baseline stage-15 and inspect target/criterion/<case>/change/estimates.json for the mean.point_estimate; fail if it exceeds regression_budget_pct.
